corrected.statement: In Istio 1.24.0, name table output no longer contains unready endpoints for headless services (bug fix). Exposed environments will see a behavior change worth reviewing.

decision.reason: [ev-58fe3b69692b] only says a bug was fixed where name table output contained unready endpoints for headless services. After the fix, things keep working but the output changes, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. The proposed statement goes further than the evidence by claiming the fix "corrects incorrect DNS resolution behavior", which the excerpt never mentions. The evidence also gives nothing to support "medium" severity, so I rewrote the statement in the evidence's own terms and set severity to low.
